Setup.Name: Kingdom Setup
Setup.Label: Open Setup
Setup.Hint: Seats, advisors, table options and the story import.

BetweenSessions.Name: Desks open between sessions
BetweenSessions.Hint: Players can manage their desks whenever the world is running. Requests made while the GM is away wait for the GM.

Approval.Name: Requests made between sessions
Approval.Hint: What happens to player requests made while no GM is connected.

TapTreasury.Name: Tap Treasury
TapTreasury.Hint: The only way to turn kingdom funds into gold. It creates a debt, adds Corruption and Unrest, and is logged by name.

AdvisorWarnings.Name: Advisor warnings
AdvisorWarnings.Hint: How plainly advisors warn the party away from regions far above their level.

PinResolved.Name: Resolved event pins
PinResolved.Hint: What happens to a map pin once its event is over.

DeskMatters.Name: Weekly desk matters
DeskMatters.Hint: Each week, a small matter lands on whichever desk has been quietest. The month's major events are drawn as usual.

Setup.Title: Kingdom Setup
Setup.AdventureImported: Adventure has been imported into this world
Setup.KingdomActive: Kingdom has been founded on the party sheet
Setup.SeatsHint: Give each seat a holder: a player character, an NPC actor, or a companion advisor. Seats held by advisors need a player to supervise them, so every desk has someone at the table looking after it.
Setup.SeatsNeedKingdom: Seat holders are saved to the PF2e kingdom, so found the kingdom first. Companion and supervisor choices are saved either way.
Setup.ShowingCompanions: Holders are limited to the party and Kingmaker companions.
Setup.ShowingAll: Showing every actor in the world.
Setup.FoundingHint: The party picks two realm stats the kingdom was built around. Each starts at rank 1. This is set once; you can undo it and pick again.
Setup.FoundingResetConfirm: Take back the founding focus? Both stats lose the rank and points it gave them.
Setup.FoundingIncomplete: Pick two different stats for the founding focus, or leave both empty.

Import.Title: Import Story Content
Import.Intro: Copy regions, locations, kingdom events, quests, characters and structures from the Kingmaker adventure into GM-only journals in this world. This only needs doing once; the originals are not changed.
Import.Reimport: Content was imported before. Pages you have edited since then will be left as they are.
Import.NotReady: The Kingmaker module must be active and its adventure imported into this world.
Import.Counts: {created} pages created, {updated} updated, {skipped} kept because you edited them.
Import.Failed: The story import failed. See the console for details.

Manager.Title: Ultimate Kingdom Manager
Manager.NoKingdom: No kingdom has been founded yet. Found it from the Kingdom tab of the party sheet.
Manager.DrawnNone: No events could be drawn right now.
Manager.RoutineHint: Everyday life in the realm. Grows faster when the stat is well behind what the kingdom's level allows.
Manager.AtCap: at the cap for this level
Manager.MatterNone: No desk matter fits right now.

Card.EscalateHint: Can be taken on by the party as an adventure
Card.NoPersonalSkill: None of your characters has a skill that fits this event.
Card.PersonalHint: Your character takes this on in person, rolling their own skill against a level-based DC. A success counts as a critical success, and a critical success earns Fame.
Card.EscalateConfirm: Take this to the table? The deadline pauses until the GM records how the party fared.
Card.DismissConfirm: Remove this card without applying any outcome?
Card.Working: {name} is on it — done in {days} days
Card.AdvisorBusy: The advisor is busy with another matter.
Card.Rolled: {name}'s roll: {result}. Reroll from the chat card, or accept it. It applies on its own after a day.

Log.food-shortfall: The treasury could not cover food upkeep. Unrest rises.

Resolve.Continues: This matter isn't over. It returns next month.
Resolve.RollFailed: Couldn't roll {name}. Check that the kingdom and skill are set up.

Request.Assigned: On it. Expect a result in {days} days.
Request.NoGM: No GM is online, and between-session play is off.
Request.Queued: No GM is online. Your request will be handled when the GM returns.

Describe.escalate: {user} wants the party to take on {card}.

Reason.NotOpen: That card is no longer open.
Reason.NoSkill: That character doesn't have that skill.
Reason.NotAssigned: Nobody is working on that card.
Reason.Timeout: The GM didn't answer. Try again.
Reason.NotReady: That stat isn't ready to rank up.
Reason.AlreadyUnderway: A rank-up for that stat is already underway.
Reason.TooPoor: The treasury needs {cost} BP for that.
Reason.NoTarget: That place isn't available for this project.
Reason.NoStructure: That structure can't be built yet.

Effect.IncomeHalved: Next month's income halved (at least 4 dice lost)
Effect.BpDice: {amount} resource dice over the next month
Effect.ConsumptionSkip: No food upkeep for a month
Effect.Reroll: A reroll to use within the month
Effect.Repeat: It will come up again next month

Rank.BeginConfirm: Spend {cost} BP and two weeks of the seat's advisor's time? The advisor can't take cards until it's done ({days} days).
Rank.Started: The rank-up is underway. It takes {days} days.
Rank.Choosing: Rank-up ready: a choice is waiting
Rank.ReadyText: The seat's holder has a choice to make on the Realm tab.

Project.Treasury: Treasury: {bp} BP. The cost is paid when the project starts.
Project.CampHint: On a hex with the matching resource the site pays double.

NoTargets.frontier: There are no unclaimed hexes next to the realm.
NoTargets.claimed-no-road: Every claimed hex already has a road.
NoTargets.claimed-no-farm: No claimed hex is free for farmland.
NoTargets.claimed-no-camp: No claimed hex is free for a work site.
NoTargets.settlement: The realm has no settlements yet.

Project.NoStructures: No structures are known yet. Import the story content first.
Project.Started: The project is on the desk. {cost} BP paid. Delegate it or handle it personally.
